from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityDemographics(BaseModel):
    """Demographic data for one university from a CDS report."""
    university_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the university")
    reporting_term: str | None = Field(description="The academic term/year the data covers, e.g., 'Fall 2021'")
    out_of_state_percentage: float | None = Field(description="Percentage of first-time, first-year students from out of state")
    college_housing_percentage: float | None = Field(description="Percentage of first-time, first-year students living in college-owned, -operated, or -affiliated housing")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    university_demographics: list[UniversityDemographics]
